title: Ask HN: What are you thankful for?
guide_zh: 年末一起聊聊值得感谢的人和事，以及生活中珍惜的支持。
author: japhyr
excerpt: I think this gets asked most years, and I always enjoy the threads that come out of it. I am thankful for a family that I enjoy spending the holidays with. I am thankful that I had a safe childhood and got a good education throughout my life. I am also thankful for the HN community. People dump on this site sometimes, but over most of the past decade HN has been an overwhelmingly positive part of my life. Thank you to everyone for what you bring to the community here.
